title: Hate Cannot Drive out Hate: Forecasting Conversation Incivility following Replies to Hate Speech

bias_targets.methodology: The authors propose a novel metric to quantify conversation incivility (which is defined to encompass expressions of bias such as racism and sexism, as well as vulgarity and personal attacks) based on the number of civil and uncivil comments and the unique authors involved. They evaluate the incivility of follow-up Reddit conversations triggered by replies to hate speech and use RoBERTa-based models to forecast these incivility levels.
